skill.name: asking-well
skill.description: Ask only for missing necessary information, with clear choices and a reasoned recommendation.
skill.instructions: Read the available context and use available reading tools before asking the person. Ask only for necessary information that remains unavailable. Do not repeat a question already answered in this run. Ask one decision per question and state what changes depending on the answer. Offer 2 to 4 mutually exclusive options, with the recommended option first and a one-line reason grounded in the available context. Preserve free text and the person’s choice. A recommendation is never an answer: wait for the person’s actual reply. This method grants no tool or permission; existing controls still apply.
